claim.reason: South_view.png shows F1:W4 (between door F1:D8 and window F1:W5) as visibly smaller and set higher than the standard 1.6m windows. Calibrated via cyan-ink pixel_profile on this same image: floor baseline at pixel y=569 (rgb 199,199,199 gray wall line, view_0011/0013 crop context), F1/F2 split line at y=396, giving 173px=3.000m (17.34mm/px). This scale was cross-validated against F1:D8 (measured width 936mm vs candidate 1500mm door width match at x, height 2098mm vs candidate 2101.6mm) and F1:W5/W6 (measured height 1595mm vs candidate 1598mm, sill 1006mm vs 1007mm) which matched the existing candidate almost exactly, confirming the calibration is reliable. F1:W4's own outer cyan frame was measured at pixel y=448 (head) and y=482 (sill), giving above-floor head/sill of 2.098m/1.509m, versus the candidate's current 2.605m/1.007m (borrowed from the standard window family). Width/x-position of F1:W4 already match the drawing closely and are not changed by this claim.
unresolved: Bottom frame line at pixel y=482 had weak isolated pixel support (count=2) in the raw color-run output; the outer rectangle bottom edge is still clearly visible in the enlarged crop view_0011/view_0013.

claims.reason: South_view.png shows F1:W4 (between door F1:D8 and window F1:W5) as visibly smaller and set higher than the standard 1.6m windows. Calibrated via cyan-ink pixel_profile on this same image: floor baseline at pixel y=569 (rgb 199,199,199 gray wall line, view_0011/0013 crop context), F1/F2 split line at y=396, giving 173px=3.000m (17.34mm/px). This scale was cross-validated against F1:D8 (measured width 936mm vs candidate 1500mm door width match at x, height 2098mm vs candidate 2101.6mm) and F1:W5/W6 (measured height 1595mm vs candidate 1598mm, sill 1006mm vs 1007mm) which matched the existing candidate almost exactly, confirming the calibration is reliable. F1:W4's own outer cyan frame was measured at pixel y=448 (head) and y=482 (sill), giving above-floor head/sill of 2.098m/1.509m, versus the candidate's current 2.605m/1.007m (borrowed from the standard window family). Width/x-position of F1:W4 already match the drawing closely and are not changed by this claim.
